channel.title: Cobble Updates
channel.description: Signed Full releases of Cobble for macOS.

item.description:
Full Cobble browser for Apple silicon and macOS 26+.
- Updated Chromium to 153.0.8010.37 with the matching public ABI 17 SDK. - Command-click and middle-click open links in background tabs. - Closing the last tab keeps the selected space. - Added page loading progress, including WebKit’s native estimate. - Rejected stale native focus callbacks and removed obsolete default-browser callback code.
Includes WebKit, Chromium and signed in-app updates.
This is an early beta. Interrupted download recovery, real-account authentication, clean-Mac installation and installed version-to-version updates remain unqualified. ABI 18 development features are not included.
Download the ZIP, extract Cobble, quit the old app and replace it in Applications. Beta 1 users need one manual install because that version’s updater cannot start.

Full Cobble browser for Apple silicon and macOS 26+.
- Apple sign-in POST and popup-message flows now stay in Chromium, avoiding the unsupported native handoff that could leave a white window. These flows use Apple's web login instead of the separate native Touch ID sheet. - Background update checks are enabled by default; existing preferences are preserved. Updates still require your approval to install.
Includes WebKit, Chromium and signed in-app updates. Real Apple account sign-in and a full installed-update cycle remain unverified.
Beta 1 users: manually download this ZIP and replace Cobble once; beta 1's updater cannot start. Beta 2 users can use Check for Updates after the signed feed is published.

Full Cobble browser for Apple silicon and macOS 26+.
Download the ZIP, extract Cobble, quit the old app, and replace Cobble in Applications.
### Fixed - Fixed Sparkle startup so Check for Updates works with signed update feeds. - Improved the message shown when the updater cannot start.
**Beta 1 users: install this download manually once.** Beta 1 cannot start its updater. This build enables future signed update checks.
Includes WebKit and Chromium. Installed version-to-version updates and clean-Mac qualification remain in progress.
